text: Tree cover was lost after 2020, but this does not prove that the owner broke any laws. The evidence shows 87.7 hectares of tree loss between 2021 and 2023. Most of this was in planted forests, which are legally managed. While the loss is confirmed, the cause (harvesting, fire, etc.) isn't known, nor is whether it was legal or authorized. The data only tracks changes in tree cover, not compliance with regulations.
